item.title: Iranian man living in Sherman Oaks hopes for regime change after being forced to flee in early 80s
item.description: With Ayatollah Ali Khamenei dead and U.S. and Israeli forces striking Iranian military targets, Dr. Payam Kade says he is clinging to the hope that the war could open the door to a democratic future.

item.title: Stranger caught on video trying to kick down Riverside family's door
item.description: A Riverside man is recalling the frightening moment a stranger repeatedly tried to kick his way inside his family's home.

item.title: Small plane hits homes in Phoenix, crashes nose-down next to backyard pool, injuring 3
item.description: A small plane struck two homes in Phoenix on Wednesday before crashing nose-down in a backyard, injuring the two people on board and a man in one of the homes, authorities said.

item.title: ﻿Iran conflict sparks anxiety; psychiatrist offer coping strategies
item.description: Operation Epic Fury is taking a mental toll for many monitoring the conflict. A psychiatrist offers advice for those feeling an emotional impact.

item.title: Former water polo player alleges sexual, racial abuse at elite LA school
item.description: A former water polo player at Harvard-Westlake has filed a lawsuit against the elite L.A. school, alleging repeated incidents of sexual assault and racial attacks.

item.title: Strong, gusty winds move into SoCal on Thursday. Here's where damaging winds are possible
item.description: Strong, gusty winds are moving into Southern California this week, bringing damaging winds to some areas.

item.title: Judge rules companies entitled to refunds for Trump tariffs overturned by SCOTUS
item.description: In a defeat for the Trump administration, a federal judge in New York ruled Wednesday that companies that paid tariffs struck down last month by Supreme Court are due refunds.

item.title: Carson couple arrested in elder abuse investigation; 10 victims rescued
item.description: Several elderly patients were rescued in Carson, where investigators say a couple was operating multiple unlicensed facilities. That couple has now been arrested on accusations of elder abuse and fraud.

item.title: Republican governor candidate Chad Bianco says he's the 'antithesis to California state government'
item.description: "I am the antithesis to California state government because I am going to take a nuclear bomb into that building and absolutely destroy everything that they do to us behind closed doors," Chad Bianco told ABC7.

item.title: Chase: Pickup truck driver leading authorities on wild pursuit through LA
item.description: A driver is leading authorities on an erratic chase through Los Angeles County Wednesday night.
